text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Opal Finance asked for a temporary APAC QPS exception for an investor demo this Friday. They expect short spike ~300 QPS for a 3 hour window. Renewal conversation is active, they said this demo is a make-or-break.
Ethan (SE): Can we get details — which endpoints/models & region? Also need IPs for allowlist.
Maya (CS): Details from the customer: region ap-southeast-1 (SG). Endpoints: /v1/generate (model: gpt-redwood-8k) and /v1/embeddings. Current QPS per-customer = 60, requested = 300 for 3h (Fri 09:00–12:00 SGT). IPs: 52.74.128.0/22, 13.250.0.0/16.
Liam (NetOps): Ok. We can create a temporary route and add those CIDRs to the APAC edge allowlist. Will need a short-lived rule with auto-revoke. ETA ~20m after approval. Any specific org ID or API key?
Maya (CS): Org: opal-finance-prod, api_key: opal-* (we'll send the full key via secure support ticket). Customer asked for no manual follow-up — wants auto revoke.
Ava (Support): Please open a support ticket so we have an audit trail. I'll attach the customer's signed demo addendum. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/87642
Ethan (SE): For safety let's pin the customer to the smaller generation profile so CPU does not balloon: set model override to gpt-redwood-8k:reduced-batch. Also enable prefix KV caching for their sessions. Proposed config snippet:
```
{
  "org": "opal-finance-prod",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "qps": 300,
  "window": "2024-11-15T09:00:00+08:00/2024-11-15T12:00:00+08:00",
  "allowlist": ["52.74.128.0/22","13.250.0.0/16"],
  "model_overrides": {"/v1/generate": "gpt-redwood-8k:reduced-batch"},
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```
Liam (NetOps): That looks fine. We'll implement as a temporary policy. I'll also set a throttled fallback to 120 QPS if burst exceeds infra thresholds.
ops-bot: Change request queued: #CR-9221 — temp-qps-exception for opal-finance-prod in ap-southeast-1. Assigned: @Liam.
Liam (NetOps): Implemented. Edge allowlist added, routing updated, temp QPS rule applied, fallback at 120 QPS. Auto-revoke timer set for 2024-11-15T12:05:00+08:00. Test logs: `200 OK` on canary calls.
Ava (Support): I uploaded the signed addendum to ticket and added the summary + rollback plan. Ticket updated: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/87642#note-5
Maya (CS): Amazing — flagging for renewal team that we handled the request and included the addendum. Customer is going to run additional stress tests tomorrow, will report any issues.
Ethan (SE): I'll monitor latency and error rates during the window and escalate if traces spike. I also added a short eval monitor to catch quality regressions from the reduced-batch override.
Maya (CS): Thanks all. Can someone post a quick post-mortem if anything goes sideways? Also confirm cost uplift estimate for billing ops.
Liam (NetOps): Will do. Quick estimate: expected incremental cost ~ $450 for the 3h burst (GPU & edge egress). I'll log the final number after the window.
ops-bot: Change request closed: #CR-9221 status=applied auto-revoke=scheduled.
Maya (CS): Closing loop — customer confirmed demo success, said it materially improved renewal sentiment. Please leave the cost note in the ticket and we'll attach to the renewal opportunity. :tada:
